Privacy & audio

HearBridge keeps transcripts and decisions in this tab’s memory. Clear session removes them and stops active audio tools. Refresh also resets the session.

On-device mode requires a compatible browser and language pack. Browser service mode may transmit speech to the browser provider. Ask everyone before enabling a microphone or reading a recap aloud.

The room meter analyzes samples in memory. Repair phrases use an installed local voice when available. Downloads persist where you save them.
